body.title: Protocol messages and the row's attachments field
body.summary: protocol.ts: add attach-image, pick-attachments, remove-attachment and open-attachment (webview to host), attachments-pending (host to webview) with PendingAttachmentView, and `attachments?` on user-row; add each new kind to its type list. session-store.ts: the user row variant gains `attachments?: readonly AttachmentRef[]`. AttachmentRef is imported as a type from attachment-store.ts, which is why this follows t1. The lists are not exhaustive today, so the test asserts each new kind by name (review finding accepted by override).
acceptanceChecks: Each of the five new kinds is in its type list and the protocol test asserts each by name
user-row and the stored user row accept attachments; a row without them has exactly today's shape
A user row with attachments round-trips through the file store unchanged

tests.name: protocol: the four new webview messages and attachments-pending are in the type lists, and user-row carries attachments
session file store: a user row with attachments round-trips unchanged
